title: Hyperbolic root stability and quadratic localization

targets.obligation: Angular root continuity, compact uniform separation and an explicit Cauchy root bound.
Fixed-radius circles give one root per uniformly separated principal branch for every fixed lower polynomial.
Bounded frequencies and the complete all-frequency complex strip, including the linear case.
A nonreal homogeneous principal root gives an exact growing frequency ray after a real sign reversal.
Exact order-m-1 perturbation, finite fractional scaling and a nonreal root persisting for every large frequency; no smooth branch needed.
Actual smooth Cauchy continuity implies a finite jet-seminorm point bound; exact plane waves contradict it at growing complex roots.
All three robust criteria, controlled smooth Cauchy sufficiency and continuity, both time directions, d0 and m1 edge cases.
One fixed root cluster, all smooth contour power sums and multiplicities without differentiated root labels.
Complete Newton recursion and monic division construct the smooth cluster factor and its nonvanishing quotient.
A nonnegative smooth variance on a full neighborhood gives the actual linear root bound, including k1.
All lower total jets vanish; compact complex polynomial scaling and circle counts prove the first nonzero homogeneous localization is hyperbolic.
Phase-space Hessian for a full weak neighborhood, k2 versus zero Hessian at higher multiplicity, and real multiplier invariance.
Complete one-sided quadratic argument: dp0 kills the variance derivative at k2; at k>=3 the Hessian factors as tL and admits another hyperbolicity direction, or is zero.
Full degenerate quadratic Lorentz expression, seminorm triangle inequality, convex component, changed directions, negative roots and complex zero-free cone.
Exact index-at-most-one bound and receiver for the full earlier symplectic Hessian classification, including zero.
Exact root splitting, amplification, Lorentz cone and one-sided cubic sections underlying the four-panel reproducible illustration.
Complete exact discontinuity sequence and one smooth periodic datum with no distributional solution; modewise ODE proof and compact-time distribution-order contradiction.
Complete three-root variance, cubic localization and vanishing full Hessian calculation.
Complete sheared cone, radical and exact root signs for a different hyperbolicity direction.
Complete one-sided homogeneous cubic, genuine nonzero characteristic, variance derivative, full Hessian and precise limits of the full-neighborhood conclusion.
